mood_trend.basis: Summarise mood check-ins over a window (14 days by default): how many entries, the average score, the highest and lowest days, and whether the second half of the window averages higher, lower or about the same as the first (offered only with at least 4 check-ins). Handler core.skills_habits_mind.mood_trend.

moon_phase.basis: The moon's phase for a date (yyyy-mm-dd, default today): its name — New Moon, Waxing Crescent, First Quarter, Full Moon and so on — roughly how much of it is lit as a percentage, and about how many days until the next full moon. Handler core.skills_travel.moon_phase.

morse_translate.basis: Translate text into Morse code, or Morse code back into text. Handler core.skills_smart_convert.morse_translate.

mouse_control.basis: Control the mouse: move to coordinates, click, double-click, right-click, or scroll. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_mouse_control.

mouse_settings.basis: Read or change the Windows mouse pointer speed. Handler core.skills_network_display_input.mouse_settings.

move_window_to_monitor.basis: Move the window you're using to another screen: 'next' (the default) cycles to the following monitor, or give a monitor number (1, 2…) or part of its name. Handler core.skills_hands3_window_manip.move_window_to_monitor.

multiverse_compile.basis: COMPILED ROUTINE ONLY, NOT EXECUTED: compile a CALLER-CHOSEN branch (exact name, never auto-chosen) from a multiverse into a readable routine + dry-run report (Build 4 proposal dry-run, plus Build 3 SIM prediction when a seed is supplied). Handler core.multiverse_tools.multiverse_compile_handler.

multiverse_compile_report.basis: COMPILED ROUTINE REPORT ONLY, NOT EXECUTED: re-compile a caller-chosen branch and write only the compiled routine + dry-run report to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.multiverse_tools.multiverse_compile_report_handler.

multiverse_plan.basis: PROPOSALS ONLY, NOT APPLIED: plan a caller-supplied multiverse for one goal — at least two branches, each a Build 4 proposal (exact diff, named regression guard, evidence ledger) with a readable routine. Handler core.multiverse_tools.multiverse_plan_handler.

music_trivia.basis: Play a guess-the-tune game: 'start' plays the first phrase of a traditional, public-domain melody (Twinkle Twinkle, Ode to Joy, Jingle Bells and friends) and asks you to name it; 'answer' with your guess checks it and keeps a running score in memory. Handler core.skills_fun_play.music_trivia.

mutual_fund_nav.basis: Ask for a mutual fund's NAV by scheme name or AMFI scheme code. Handler core.mutual_fund.mutual_fund_nav.

name_generator.basis: Deal fresh names from VYUK's own combinatorial banks (each kind holds 500+ possible combinations): 'character' (first + last names from many cultures), 'band' (adjective + noun, sometimes with 'The'), 'startup' (syllable-join names like Novaly or Quanhub), 'pet' (names, often with an epithet — 'Miso the Brave'), 'fantasy_place' (Emberfell-style joined names) and 'superhero' ('Captain Comet'-style title + noun). Handler core.skills_creative2_words_names.name_generator.

nato_spell.basis: Spell a word out in the NATO phonetic alphabet — Alfa, Bravo, Charlie and so on — so it can be read over a crackly phone line without confusion. Handler core.skills_smart_convert.nato_spell.

net_network_descriptor.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NEVER PROBED OR SCANNED: return an own-network descriptor from a caller-supplied network label and a scope of exactly 'own' or 'administered' — a name the caller gave the network, never probed, never scanned, never measured, never resolved. Handler core.net_tools.net_network_descriptor_handler.

net_network_status.basis: STATUS ONLY, NEVER POLLED LIVE: return a network-status descriptor from caller-supplied status words and a timestamp — the status as supplied, never polled live, never measured. Handler core.net_tools.net_network_status_handler.

net_readonly_check.basis: READ-ONLY CHECK ONLY, NEVER RESOLVED OR CONNECTED: return 'own-network as supplied', 'missing', or 'outside own network — refused' for a caller-supplied target label and scope. Handler core.net_tools.net_readonly_check_handler.

net_record_network.basis: RECORD ONLY, NOTHING SCANNED, NOTHING CONNECTED: re-validate a caller-supplied network (descriptor or status) by re-running the builder that made it, and write only the network record to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.net_tools.net_record_network_handler.

network_adapters.basis: List the PC's network adapters with their state (up/down), link speed, MAC address and IPv4 address; show_ipv6=true also names each adapter's IPv6 address. Handler core.skills_network_diag.network_adapters.

network_quality.basis: Measure how responsive the internet connection feels right now: five timed test connections to public DNS servers (1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8) give a median latency and jitter, graded excellent / good / fair / slow — or honestly unreachable when every test fails. Handler core.skills_nose.network_quality.

note_frequency.basis: Give the frequency of a musical note: a letter A–G with an optional sharp or flat and an octave, like A4, C#5 or Bb3. Handler core.skills_music.note_frequency.

notes.basis: Take a note, list your notes, read one back, or remove one. Handler core.skills_notes.notes.

notify_user.basis: Show a Windows toast notification with a title and a message — for getting the user's attention when they're not looking at VYUK The result only claims the notification showed when Windows accepted it. Handler core.skills_desktop_prefs.notify_user.

number_guess.basis: Play the number-guessing game: VYUK thinks of a number between 1 and 100. Handler core.skills_games_classic.number_guess.

occluded_capture.basis: Attempt an occluded-window capture of a named window. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_occluded_capture.

ocr_file.basis: Read the text inside an image FILE (a screenshot, scan or photo of text) using OCR, and return the words. Handler core.skills_media.ocr_file.

ocr_screen.basis: Read the text currently visible on screen using OCR (her bundled text-reading engine). Handler core.desktop.control_system.ocr_screen.

ollama_delete.basis: Delete a model and its data from the local Ollama server, freeing its disk space. Handler core.ollama_models.ollama_delete.

ollama_pull.basis: Download a model into the local Ollama server, e.g. Handler core.ollama_models.ollama_pull.

ollama_status.basis: Check the local Ollama server: is it running, which version, which models are installed and how big they are, and is the local brain's configured model among them? Read-only — nothing is downloaded or deleted. Handler core.ollama_models.ollama_status.

open_path.basis: Open a file or folder with the operating system's default application (like double-clicking it). Handler core.desktop.control_system.open_path.

open_settings_page.basis: Open a Windows Settings page by name: home, bluetooth, wifi, network, display, sound, apps, personalization, update, battery, storage, privacy, accounts, time, gaming, accessibility, startup, notifications or defaultapps. Handler core.skills_desktop_prefs.open_settings_page.

open_url.basis: Visit a website: open a web page or URL in the user's default browser — or in a named browser (chrome, edge, firefox) when the user asks for one. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_open_url.

optimise.basis: Solve a combinatorial optimisation problem the operator describes: travelling-salesman and vehicle-routing tours, bin packing, knapsack, shortest paths, assignment, max flow, linear programming and small constraint problems. Handler core.optimise.optimise.

organise_photos.basis: Sort a camera dump into dated, location-aware folders (elodie's scheme, own code — elodie itself is NOT adopted: its wheel pins 2017-2018 versions that conflict with this tree). Handler core.photo_organise.organise_photos.

oven_temp_convert.basis: Convert an oven temperature between celsius, fahrenheit and gas mark, and give all three forms. Handler core.skills_kitchen_scale.oven_temp_convert.

overdue_promises.basis: List promises past their due date, oldest first, from VYUK's local promise store. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_overdue_promises.

packing_list.basis: Generate a trip packing list for a destination and trip length: clothing counts scale with the days, and the list is tuned to the live weather there right now (jacket and layers when cold, umbrella when it's raining, light fabrics when hot). Handler core.skills_productivity3_life_admin.packing_list.

page_change_summary.basis: Say what changed on a page since the last check, in plain words: fetches the page, compares its headline lines with the saved snapshot, lists the new and removed lines, then saves the new snapshot. Handler core.skills_web6_watch.page_change_summary.

page_watch.basis: Watch a web page for changes. Handler core.skills_web_research.page_watch.

page_word_search.basis: Find a word or phrase on a web page and show the text around each match. Handler core.skills_web_lookup.page_word_search.

palette_image.basis: The picture version of generate_palette: build a five-colour harmony (complementary, analogous, triadic, monochrome, or random) from a base colour as #RRGGBB (or a random hue when empty) and save it as a 1200×240 PNG swatch — five bands, each labelled with its hex in contrasting text (PIL's built-in font; no fancy typeface). Handler core.skills_studio.palette_image.

pantry_check.basis: Check a recipe against the cupboard: give what you have and what the recipe needs, both as comma lists, and get back just what's missing — a small difference in plurals ('egg' vs 'eggs') is forgiven. Handler core.skills_kitchen_plan.pantry_check.

passive_voice_check.basis: A heuristic check for passive voice in a text: flags sentences where a be-verb (am/is/are/was/were/be/been/being) is closely followed by a participle-shaped word, reports what percentage of sentences are flagged, and quotes up to three examples. Handler core.skills_words_measure.passive_voice_check.

password_strength.basis: Analyse a password's strength and report a verdict: an entropy estimate from its length and character pool, minus pattern penalties (common-password list, sequences like 'abc'/'321', repeated characters or chunks, keyboard walks, digits-only), and the average crack time at offline (10 billion guesses/second) and online (10 thousand/second) rates. Handler core.skills_productivity2_convert_query.password_strength.

paste_snippet.basis: Paste a saved snippet into the currently focused app: its text is put on the clipboard and Ctrl+V is sent. Handler core.skills_productivity.paste_snippet.

paste_text.basis: Paste text straight into whatever window is focused right now (puts it on the clipboard, then sends Ctrl+V). Handler core.skills_network_display_input.paste_text.

path_audit.basis: Audit PATH for rot: entries that no longer exist on disk (the classic leftovers from uninstalled or moved programs), entries listed more than once, and relative entries. Handler core.skills_system_net_admin.path_audit.

pdf_extract_images.basis: Extract the images EMBEDDED in a PDF and save them as files (JPEG/PNG/etc. Handler core.skills_files4_image.pdf_extract_images.

pdf_info.basis: Report a PDF's facts: PDF version (from the file header), file size, page count, the first page's size in millimetres (and points), and the document metadata — title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, and creation/modification dates — when present, plus whether the file is encrypted. Handler core.skills_files3_inspect.pdf_info.

pdf_merge_bookmarks.basis: Merge two or more PDFs into one — paths given as ONE semicolon-separated list, in the order they should appear — adding a PDF bookmark named after each source file at the page where it starts (plain merge_pdfs adds none). Handler core.skills_files5_pdf.pdf_merge_bookmarks.

pdf_split_by_text.basis: Split a PDF wherever a page's text contains a marker phrase (e.g. Handler core.skills_files5_pdf.pdf_split_by_text.

peripheral_roll_call.basis: List the USB and Bluetooth devices connected right now by their friendly names, and compare with the last saved snapshot (kept in VYUK's data folder) to name anything missing or newly appeared. Handler core.skills_system6_devices.peripheral_roll_call.

personal_skills.basis: Manage the user's own personal skills in Documents/VYUK Skills: list them, inspect one (its steps are shown as data, never run), admit a draft after its SKILL.md validates and its safety scan passes, or run one admitted skill's declared, VYUK-signed WASM module inside the contained runtime (confirmation required; anything undeclared, unsigned, or untrusted is refused and nothing executes). Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_personal_skills.

pet_feeding_log.basis: Keep a log of pet feedings — just the record, no feeding advice. Handler core.skills_outdoors_home.pet_feeding_log.

phase5_interface_describe.basis: INTERFACE DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NEVER A REDESIGN: validate a surface descriptor inside the frozen UI core (surface, rows, actions). Handler core.phase5_tools.phase5_interface_describe_handler.

phase5_report.basis: PHASE 5 CLUSTER REPORT ONLY, NOTHING EXECUTED: re-run one Phase 5 cluster operation (interface, ent, plat, or fin — port has its own round-trip tool) and write only that cluster's report to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.phase5_tools.phase5_report_handler.

photo_face_blur.basis: Blur the faces in a photo before sharing it: OpenCV's Haar detector finds front-facing faces and each one is pixelated into a mosaic. Handler core.skills_files5_watch_blur_notes.photo_face_blur.

pilot_bench.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOTHING PROBED OR MEASURED: return a project-bench descriptor from a caller-supplied project name plus bench notes (P15-7 lab notebook, record form only). Handler core.pilot_tools.pilot_bench_handler.

pilot_build_steps.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NEVER RUN: return a build-step descriptor from caller-supplied step labels plus an assumptions note (P15-10 blueprint plan record; P16-10 worked steps). Handler core.pilot_tools.pilot_build_steps_handler.

pilot_dev_workflow.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NEVER RUN, NEVER DEPLOYED, NEVER SIGNED: return a dev-workflow descriptor from a caller-supplied repo label plus workflow step labels (P17-1 terminal dry-run, plan record; P17-4 policy as code, rule labels as steps). Handler core.pilot_tools.pilot_dev_workflow_handler.

pilot_record_pilot.basis: RECORD ONLY, NOTHING RUN, READ, DEPLOYED, OR SIGNED: re-validate a caller-supplied pilot descriptor (bench, build-steps, study-session, revision-plan, dev-workflow, or review-note) by re-running the builder that made it, and write only the pilot record to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.pilot_tools.pilot_record_pilot_handler.

pilot_review_note.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOTHING APPROVED OR MERGED: return a code-review-note descriptor from caller-supplied file:line cites plus notes (P17-11 stack trace to cause, cite-and-note form; P17-12 pre-push guardian, check notes only; P17-14 diff storyteller, caller-supplied summary notes plus cites). Handler core.pilot_tools.pilot_review_note_handler.

pilot_revision_plan.basis: PLAN RECORD ONLY, NOTHING SCHEDULED: return a revision-plan descriptor from caller-supplied topics in order (P16-2 study plan that bends, plan record; P16-12 concept maps, topics record). Handler core.pilot_tools.pilot_revision_plan_handler.

pilot_study_session.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOTHING GENERATED OR READ LIVE: return a study-session descriptor from a caller-supplied subject, materials, and questions (P16-6 quiet question bank, record form). Handler core.pilot_tools.pilot_study_session_handler.

ping_host.basis: Ping a host name or IP address and report average response time (with the fastest and slowest replies) and packet loss. Handler core.skills_network_wifi_net.ping_host.

pixelate_image.basis: Pixelate ONE picture into retro pixel art, saving the result as a NEW file — the original is never touched. Handler core.skills_photo2_effects.pixelate_image.

plant_care_log.basis: Keep a log of house plants and when each was last watered. Handler core.skills_outdoors_home.plant_care_log.

plat_tools_record.basis: PROGRAMME RECORD ONLY, NEVER ENFORCEMENT: validate a lifecycle / rollout / governance record (kind, name, state, note). Handler core.phase5_tools.plat_tools_record_handler.

play_music.basis: Play music — starts actual playback. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_play_music.

pomodoro.basis: Run a Pomodoro focus timer on VYUK's reminder list: schedules an announcement when each focus round ends ('Pomodoro done — take a break') and, between rounds, when each break ends, for as many cycles as asked. Handler core.skills_productivity2_timers.pomodoro.

port_roundtrip.basis: SINGLE-DEVICE PORT ROUND-TRIP ONLY, CALLER ACTION, NEVER AUTOMATIC: export a caller-supplied record set to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder, re-read that file, and prove the round-trip byte-for-byte on the canonical record JSON. Handler core.phase5_tools.port_roundtrip_handler.

portfolio_tracker.basis: Track a portfolio of holdings: what you hold and what it's worth. Handler core.skills_money_budget.portfolio_tracker.

power_control.basis: Power actions: shutdown or restart the computer (both require confirm=true), or put it to sleep. Handler core.desktop.control_system.power_control.

power_plans.basis: List Windows power plans (Balanced, High performance, Power saver...) showing which is active, or switch the active plan by name. Handler core.skills_system_services_power.power_plans.

power_requests.basis: Show what is currently keeping this PC awake — processes, drivers or settings that have filed power requests blocking sleep or display-off (powercfg /requests). Handler core.skills_system3_power.power_requests.

practice_log.basis: Log music practice and look back at it. Handler core.skills_music.practice_log.

presence_report.basis: Sketch the shape of today (or yesterday) from what the watchers noticed. Handler core.skills_senses_reports.presence_report.

press_hotkey.basis: Press a key or key combination, e.g. Handler core.desktop.control_input.press_hotkey.

preview_photo_organisation.basis: Show exactly what organising a photo folder would do — which photos would move where — without moving, creating or writing anything. Handler core.photo_organise.preview_photo_organisation.

price_per_unit.basis: Compare two offers fairly by price per unit of size — a big pack against a small one. Handler core.skills_money_growth.price_per_unit.

price_watch.basis: Watch a product page's price. Handler core.skills_web6_watch.price_watch.

print_file.basis: Print a file on the default printer (documents, PDFs, images — whatever Windows can print for that file type). Handler core.skills_plus_apps_files.print_file.

privacy_usage.basis: Show which apps most recently used this PC's camera, microphone, and location (from Windows' own CapabilityAccessManager consent records), including anything that appears to be using a sensor right now. Handler core.skills_system_tuning.privacy_usage.

proactivity_bench_results.basis: List the most recent proactivity bench runs (F1, precision, recall, confusion counts). Handler core.proactivity.proactivity_bench_results_handler.

process_control.basis: Inspect running processes: 'list' (top 15 by CPU), 'top_memory' (top 10 by RAM), or 'kill_pid' to terminate one process by pid and verify that it actually exited — kill_pid requires confirm=true. Handler core.desktop.control_plus_desktop.process_control.

prompt_tune.basis: Local prompt optimisation + evaluation — the optimisation half of DSPy, rebuilt from scratch (no code adopted). Handler core.prompt_tune.prompt_tune.

public_ip.basis: Look up this internet connection's public IP address (the one websites see). Handler core.skills_network_wifi_net.public_ip.

qr_decode_image.basis: Read a QR code from an image file and report exactly what it says — a link or plain text. Handler core.skills_web6_local.qr_decode_image.

quick_math.basis: Evaluate a pure-arithmetic expression and return the exact result: + - * / // % **, parentheses, sqrt/sin/cos/tan/asin/acos/atan/log/log10/exp/abs/round/min/max/floor/ceil, and pi/e/tau. Handler core.skills_smart.quick_math.

quiz_me.basis: Build a four-option multiple-choice question from the user's own flashcards: one card's front, its back plus three other cards' backs as distractors, lettered A to D. Handler core.skills_study_drills.quiz_me.

quote_of_morning.basis: Give one quote for the day from a built-in bank of public-domain classics (Franklin, Thoreau, Dickinson, Shakespeare and friends), matched to the theme of your first calendar event when Google Calendar is connected — work, travel, family, health, study or celebration — or a general quote when there's no event. Handler core.skills_fun_daily.quote_of_morning.

quote_vault.basis: A small vault for treasured quotes, stored in VYUK's memory so they survive restarts. Handler core.skills_words_make.quote_vault.

rain_from_forecast.basis: Read the rain chances out of a forecast the user pastes in. Handler core.skills_outdoors_sky.rain_from_forecast.

random_choice.basis: Pick one option at random from a comma-separated list ('pizza, sushi, tacos') — for coin-flip moments, not real decisions. Handler core.skills_smart_chance.random_choice.

read_clipboard.basis: Read the text on the system clipboard. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_read_clipboard.

read_file.basis: Read text content from a file on disk, one page at a time. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_read_file.

read_page_aloud.basis: Fetch a web page and return its article text ready to be read aloud: the title and word count, then the main text with menus, ads and scripts stripped out. Handler core.skills_web6_watch.read_page_aloud.

read_pdf_text.basis: Read the words out of a PDF file and return them as text (first pages only; scanned-image PDFs have no readable text). Handler core.skills_plus_apps_files.read_pdf_text.

read_selection_aloud.basis: Read aloud whatever text is currently selected in any app: copies the selection with Ctrl+C, speaks it in the system voice, and puts the clipboard back exactly as it was. Handler core.skills_senses_checks.read_selection_aloud.

reading_level.basis: Estimate how hard a piece of text is to read: a Flesch reading-ease score out of 100 with a plain-English band, a US school-grade estimate, and the word, sentence and syllable counts behind them. Handler core.skills_study_drills.reading_level.

reading_list.basis: Keep a reading list: books queued against books finished. Handler core.skills_productivity5_logs.reading_list.

reading_time.basis: Estimate how long a text takes to read: word count, minutes to read silently at 200 words per minute and minutes read aloud at 130 words per minute (both rates are stated in the answer). Handler core.skills_words_measure.reading_time.

recall_day.basis: Recall what happened on a day from VYUK's episodic journal: session summaries, notable actions, and notes the user pinned with remember_today. Handler core.memory.episodes.recall_day.

recall_memories.basis: Search persistent long-term memory for previously stored facts or notes. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_recall_memories.

recent_files.basis: List the files the user recently opened, newest first, from the Windows Recent list. Handler core.skills_media.recent_files.

recipe_scale.basis: Scale a recipe up or down: give the ingredients, one per line, each starting with its amount (whole numbers, decimals, fractions like 1/2 and mixed amounts like 1 1/2 all work), and a factor — 2 doubles, 0.5 halves. Handler core.skills_kitchen_scale.recipe_scale.

record_audio.basis: Record the microphone for the given number of seconds (1–120) and save the clip as a .wav file in VYUK's recordings folder. Handler core.skills_media.record_audio.

regex_test.basis: Test a Python regular expression against a block of text. Handler core.skills_dev_explain.regex_test.

registry_read.basis: Look INSIDE the Windows registry without changing anything (read-only by design — VYUK never writes to the registry with this tool): give a path starting with HKCU, HKLM or HKCR to list its values, and optionally a value name to read just that one. Handler core.skills_system_env_disk.registry_read.

release_checklist.basis: RELEASE CHECKLIST ONLY, NOT A SHIP: evaluate the release checklist (version single-source, signed manifest integrity, data baseline, registry/catalogue grouping, battery, CC-1 report, installer files) against caller-supplied evidence. Handler core.release_checklist_tools.release_checklist_handler.

release_checklist_report.basis: CHECKLIST REPORT ONLY, NOT A SHIP: re-evaluate the release checklist and write only the report to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.release_checklist_tools.release_checklist_report_handler.

release_describe.basis: DESCRIBE ONLY, NOTHING RELEASED OR SIGNED: describe install routes, a release structure check, or a release train with gates, from caller-supplied fields only. Handler core.release_spine_tools.release_describe_handler.

release_record.basis: RECORD ONLY, NOTHING RELEASED OR SIGNED: re-validate a caller-supplied release descriptor (route, verify, or train) by re-running the builder that made it, and write only the release record to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.release_spine_tools.release_record_handler.

remember_person.basis: Store a person the user mentioned - name, relationship and a note - in VYUK's local people store, so it can be recalled later. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_remember_person.

remember_promise.basis: Store a promise the user made to someone - who, what was promised, and when it is due - in VYUK's local promise store. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_remember_promise.

remember_today.basis: Pin a note to today's episodic journal so it becomes part of the day's record (e.g. Handler core.memory.episodes.remember_today.

remember_user_fact.basis: Store something the user asked you to remember — a preference, personal fact, habit, instruction, or any passing detail — into long-term persistent memory. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_remember_fact.

rent_split.basis: Split a total — rent, a deposit, any shared cost — between people in proportion to share weights such as room sizes or fractions. Handler core.skills_money_growth.rent_split.

replace_in_file.basis: Find and replace a literal string inside a file, editing it in place. Handler core.skills_text.replace_in_file.

replay_programme.basis: Replay a recorded programme of her own successful tool calls through the funnel, in order. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_replay_programme.

reschedule_calendar_event.basis: Move one event on the user's Google Calendar to a new time, by its title (and the day, if it could be more than one) or by its event id. Handler core.google_services_calendar.reschedule_event.

research.basis: Research metadata only, through a caller-supplied fetcher; the funnel supplies none, so a live funnel call reports honestly unavailable instead of sending a request. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_research.

resize_image.basis: Resize ONE image (keeping its format), saving the result as a NEW file — the original is never touched. Handler core.skills_media_convert.resize_image.

restore_backup.basis: Restore a backup snapshot into a folder you choose, using the rustic engine. Handler core.rustic_backup._tool_restore_backup.

restore_point_before_changes.basis: Create a safety restore point before making changes, then verify it: the point is created with Checkpoint-Computer and confirmed by reading the restore-point list back — the result names the point and its creation time, or says honestly if creation or confirmation failed. Handler core.skills_system6_safety.restore_point_before_changes.

restore_window_layout.basis: Restore a saved window layout: every recorded window that is open under exactly the same title is moved back to its saved position and the result is confirmed by reading the position back. Handler core.skills_desktop_layouts.restore_window_layout.

rhythm_subdivide.basis: Give the length in milliseconds of every common note value at a tempo: whole, half, quarter, eighth and sixteenth notes, plus eighth and quarter triplets. Handler core.skills_music.rhythm_subdivide.

riddle_time.basis: Play a riddle game: 'ask' serves a classic riddle. Handler core.skills_fun_party.riddle_time.

rock_paper_scissors.basis: Play rock-paper-scissors against VYUK She picks fairly at random, the result names both throws and who won, and the running score — your wins, her wins, draws — is kept in memory. Handler core.skills_fun_party.rock_paper_scissors.

roll_dice.basis: Roll dice in tabletop notation: NdM with an optional +K or -K modifier — '2d6+3', 'd20', '3d8-1' (default '1d6'). Handler core.skills_smart_chance.roll_dice.

roman_convert.basis: Convert between ordinary numbers and Roman numerals. Handler core.skills_smart_convert.roman_convert.

room_brightness.basis: Check how lit the room is by taking ONE webcam frame and measuring its average brightness (dark / dim / lit / bright, as a percentage). Handler core.skills_nose.room_brightness.

room_noise_level.basis: Listen to the room for about five seconds and report how noisy it is in words — quiet room, calm office, busy office or loud — with the measured average level. Handler core.skills_senses_checks.room_noise_level.

rotate_image.basis: Rotate ONE image, saving the result as a NEW file — the original is never touched. Handler core.skills_photo_edit.rotate_image.

rotate_pdf.basis: Rotate pages of a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees, saving the result as a NEW file ('<name>_rotated.pdf' beside the input by default; never overwritten — a ' (2)'-style suffix is used and reported). Handler core.skills_files3_inspect.rotate_pdf.

rss_digest.basis: Read an RSS 2.0 or Atom feed and digest its newest headlines: the feed's title, then the top items (5 by default, up to 25) with each item's title, date when the feed gives one, and link. Handler core.skills_web_research.rss_digest.

run_anticipation_routine.basis: Run a saved anticipation routine: executes each of its plain-language steps in order, resolving each step to a tool call at run time. Handler core.w7_wiring_anticipation.run_anticipation_routine.

run_command.basis: Run a shell command on the user's computer and return its output. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_run_command.

run_plan.basis: Run a saved plan: walks its steps in order, executing each step's tool call. Handler core.brain.planner_plans.run_plan_tool.

run_proactivity_bench.basis: Run the 36-case proactivity bench: scripted scenarios with known right/wrong intervention decisions, scored for precision/recall/F1. Handler core.proactivity.run_proactivity_bench_handler.

run_routine.basis: Run a saved routine: executes each of its tool calls in order. Handler core.brain.planner_routines.run_routine_as_task.

run_workflow.basis: Run a defined workflow end-to-end: each node calls its funnel tool through the normal gate stack (a workflow grants no tool any permission its own gate would refuse), with retries only for transient handler errors, per-task timeouts, and a bounded run budget. Handler core.dagflow.run_workflow_handler.

safe_eject_all.basis: Safely eject every removable (USB) drive in one call, then check each one actually left: any drive that refuses is named, with the likely reason (usually a program still using it). Handler core.skills_system6_devices.safe_eject_all.

sandbox_list.basis: List files inside an existing light sandbox directory. Handler core.sandbox_tools.sandbox_list_handler.

sandbox_run.basis: Run test/dry-run file actions inside a bounded light sandbox directory: writes, reads, and deletes confined to that directory (symlink-resolved), core/data/.env paths refused outright, send/network/purchase/execute kinds refused outright, promotion request-only and never performed here. Handler core.sandbox_tools.sandbox_run_handler.

save_routine.basis: Save a named routine: an ordered list of tool calls that can be replayed with run_routine. Handler core.brain.planner_routines.save_routine.

save_snippet.basis: Save a named piece of text (an address, an email signature, a bank-details block, a standard reply…) so it can be pasted later with paste_snippet. Handler core.skills_productivity.save_snippet.

save_window_layout.basis: Save the current arrangement of open windows (each window's title and position, including minimized windows' normal positions) as a named layout, so it can be restored later with restore_window_layout. Handler core.skills_desktop_layouts.save_window_layout.

saved_wifi_networks.basis: List the Wi-Fi networks this PC has saved profiles for — the networks it has connected to before and will rejoin automatically. Handler core.skills_network_diag.saved_wifi_networks.

savings_goal.basis: Work out how long a savings goal takes: give the target, what goes in each month, optionally a yearly growth rate and what's already saved. Handler core.skills_money_growth.savings_goal.

scale_notes.basis: Spell out the notes of a scale from a root note: major, natural minor, harmonic minor, major and minor pentatonic, blues, dorian and mixolydian ('minor' works as a short name for natural minor). Handler core.skills_music.scale_notes.

scan_wifi_networks.basis: The Wi-Fi radar: scan the networks in range and report each one's strongest signal, whether it's secured, the channel its loudest access point sits on, and how many access points carry the name — strongest first, up to 25. Handler core.skills_nose.scan_wifi_networks.

scheduled_agents.basis: Scheduled agents: manage VYUK's scheduled jobs and the morning digest. Handler core.scheduled_agents.scheduled_agents.

score_intervention.basis: Score one candidate intervention and record the measurement: 'what would you have done?' Returns the score, the threshold, the decision (intervene/silent) and the reasons — measurement only, no action is ever taken. Handler core.proactivity.score_intervention_handler.

screen_break_plan.basis: Plan breaks for a stretch of screen time: the time is split into work blocks (20 minutes each by default, changeable), every block is followed by a 5-minute break, and with a start time (HH:MM) the result includes the finishing clock time. Handler core.skills_habits_tracking.screen_break_plan.

screen_brightness_auto.basis: Match the screen brightness to the room: measures the room's light from one webcam frame, sets the screen to a matching level and reports the level set. Handler core.skills_senses_checks.screen_brightness_auto.

screen_diff.basis: Compare the screen now against a saved baseline picture and describe what changed in words: how much of the screen changed and in which areas (top-left, centre, bottom-right…). Handler core.skills_hands3_capture_scroll.screen_diff.

screen_look.basis: Look at the screen right now in one call: captures a frame, shows it to the model when the current session can view images, and always returns an OCR summary of the visible text plus the active window's title. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_capture_launch.ToolHandlersCaptureLaunchMixin._tool_screen_look.

screen_time_today.basis: Estimate today's active use: folds the time since the last check into a small day counter (kept in VYUK's data folder) using the Windows idle-time reading, so time away from the keyboard isn't counted. Handler core.skills_system6_devices.screen_time_today.

screenshot_region.basis: Take a verified screenshot of one rectangular part of the screen (top-left corner x, y and width, height in pixels; coordinates may be negative on multi-monitor setups) and save it as an image file — to VYUK's screenshots folder by default, or to the given path (an existing file is never overwritten; a suffixed copy is saved instead). Handler core.skills_screen_capture.screenshot_region.

screenshot_to_text_note.basis: Read the text out of a screenshot image and save it as a dated text note ('<name>_text_YYYY-MM-DD.txt') beside the image, reporting the note's path and how the text starts. Handler core.skills_files5_watch_blur_notes.screenshot_to_text_note.

scroll_until_found.basis: Scroll the focused window down step by step, reading the screen with OCR after each scroll, until a word or phrase appears — then report where it is. Handler core.skills_hands3_capture_scroll.scroll_until_found.

search_email.basis: Search the user's Gmail inbox with a Gmail search query (a name, a subject word, 'from:someone', 'subject:invoice', or plain words) and return the matching messages. Handler core.google_services_gmail.search_email.

search_file_contents.basis: Search inside the user's text files for a word or phrase (case-insensitive) and return file:line matches with snippets. Handler core.skills_system2_processes.search_file_contents.

search_indexed_files.basis: Search the indexed files for words or a phrase and return the best matches first, ranked by relevance, with a snippet from each file. Handler core.disk_index.search_indexed_files.

security_scan.basis: Scan installed software for known vulnerabilities, secrets and licences, and generate a package inventory. Handler core.security_scan.security_scan.

security_status.basis: Windows security posture in one summary: whether Defender antivirus and real-time protection are on, when signatures last updated and the last quick scan ended, plus the on/off state of the Domain/Private/Public firewall profiles. Handler core.skills_system3_security.security_status.

semantic_search_knowledge.basis: Search VYUK's local knowledge store by meaning, not words: embeds the query with the on-device MiniLM model and returns the semantically nearest stored passages (cosine order) with citations. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_semantic_search_knowledge.

semver_compare.basis: Compare two semantic versions (major.minor.patch, with an optional prerelease like -beta.1) and say which is newer — or that they are the same. Handler core.skills_dev_explain.semver_compare.

send_email.basis: Send an email from the user's Gmail account. Handler core.google_services_gmail.send_email.

sense_trends.basis: Summarise how the room's noise or light has been trending over the last few hours. Handler core.skills_senses_reports.sense_trends.

sentence_stats.basis: Measure the sentence shape of a text: how many sentences, the average words per sentence, the longest and shortest sentence (quoted, truncated at 120 characters), and what share of sentences run over 25 words — the share where readers tend to get lost. Handler core.skills_words_measure.sentence_stats.

service_control.basis: Start, stop or restart a Windows service by its service name (see list_services). Handler core.skills_system_services_power.service_control.

service_schedule.basis: Track recurring upkeep — bike services, purifier filter changes, laptop deep-cleans — by when it was last done and how many months sit between services; the next due date is computed and stored. Handler core.skills_admin_schedules.service_schedule.

session_identity.basis: Report the current Windows-profile identity (USERNAME + USERPROFILE from the OS profile, never a VYUK-minted account). Handler core.triage3_identity_redact_select.session_identity_handler.

set_brightness.basis: Set the screen brightness from 0 to 100. Handler core.desktop.control_system.set_brightness.

set_default_printer.basis: Make an already-installed printer the Windows default printer. Handler core.skills_system2_devices.set_default_printer.

set_discord_client_id.basis: Save your own Discord application ID (the Application ID from your application at discord.com/developers/applications, 17 to 19 digits) so discord_presence knows which application to show presence under. Handler core.discord_presence._tool_set_discord_client_id.

set_focus_assist.basis: Turn Windows Focus Assist (do-not-disturb) on or off. Handler core.skills_plus_voice_focus.set_focus_assist.

set_microphone_mute.basis: Mute or unmute the PC's microphone itself (the input device — use app_volume for one app's sound, set_volume_level for the speakers). Handler core.skills_media.set_microphone_mute.

set_process_priority.basis: Set one running process's CPU priority (idle, below_normal, normal, above_normal, high) — higher priority gets CPU first under load. Handler core.skills_system_tuning.set_process_priority.

set_refresh_rate.basis: Set the PRIMARY display's refresh rate (Hz). Handler core.skills_display_settings.set_refresh_rate.

set_reminder.basis: Set a reminder that VYUK speaks aloud after the specified number of minutes — or at a clock time when `at` is given ('17:30', today if ahead else tomorrow). Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_set_reminder.

set_resolution.basis: Change a monitor's resolution (monitor number from display_details). Handler core.skills_network_display_input.set_resolution.

set_screen_rotation.basis: Rotate the PRIMARY display to 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees (0 is the normal landscape orientation). Handler core.skills_display_settings.set_screen_rotation.

set_screen_timeout.basis: Set how many minutes before Windows turns the display off, on battery, when plugged in, or both. Handler core.skills_system2_devices.set_screen_timeout.

set_startup_program.basis: Enable or disable a startup program for THIS user's account, reversibly: disabling moves its entry into VYUK's safekeeping (never deletes it), enabling restores it exactly. Handler core.skills_system_apps_startup.set_startup_program.

set_volume_level.basis: Set the master volume to an EXACT percentage (0-100), unlike adjust_volume which only steps up/down. Handler core.desktop.control_plus_volume_network.set_volume_level.

set_wallpaper.basis: Set the Windows desktop wallpaper to an image file, choosing how it fills the screen: fill (default, crops to fit), fit (whole picture, bars if needed), stretch, tile, center, or span (across monitors). Handler core.skills_desktop_prefs.set_wallpaper.

shopping_list.basis: Work with the persistent spoken shopping list: 'add' puts an item on it, 'remove' takes one off, 'read' (the default) reads the whole list back numbered, 'clear' empties it. Handler core.skills_productivity3_life_admin.shopping_list.

shred_file.basis: PERMANENTLY destroy ONE file: overwrite its full contents with random data (1–3 passes), truncate it to zero and delete it, so normal undelete tools can't bring it back. Handler core.skills_files2_pdf_files.shred_file.

signature_block.basis: Build an email signature block from a name plus optional role, organisation, phone and website. Handler core.skills_words_measure.signature_block.

silence_trim.basis: Trim the long silences out of a WAV recording: stretches quieter than threshold_db (default -40 dB) and longer than min_silence_s (default 1 second) are cut down to 0.25 s each. Handler core.skills_files5_audio_dup_age.silence_trim.

sim_predict_plan.basis: PREDICTION ONLY, NOT EXECUTED: predict what a caller-supplied file plan (write/delete operations) would do to a caller-supplied snapshot of files — which files would be created, overwritten, or deleted, with byte counts and hashes — by applying the plan to a throwaway sandbox copy, diffing it, and discarding it. Handler core.sim_tools.sim_predict_plan_handler.

sim_predict_report.basis: PREDICTION REPORT ONLY, NOT EXECUTED: re-run a plan-effect prediction and write the prediction (not the plan's effects) to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.sim_tools.sim_predict_report_handler.

site_permissions_review.basis: List which websites the browser has been allowed to use the camera, microphone, location or notifications for, by reading the Chrome/Edge profile settings files. Handler core.skills_web6_local.site_permissions_review.

sleep_states.basis: Show which sleep states this PC supports (S3 sleep, hibernate, hybrid sleep, fast startup availability and friends) as reported by powercfg /a, including why any state is unavailable. Handler core.skills_system3_power.sleep_states.

slug_maker.basis: Turn a title into a URL slug: lowercase, accents folded to plain ASCII (é becomes e), every run of non-alphanumerics becomes a single hyphen, leading/trailing hyphens trimmed, capped at 80 characters with the trim disclosed. Handler core.skills_words_measure.slug_maker.

sniff_file.basis: Inspect a file before trusting it: its real contents type (read from its magic bytes) versus what its filename claims — a mismatch ('named .pdf, actually a ZIP archive') is called out loudly — plus its size, the full SHA-256 fingerprint (the hash covers the first 16 MB for very large files), an archive summary for ZIPs (entry count, uncompressed size, a possible-zip-bomb flag when it claims to expand over 100×) and line/encoding stats for text. Handler core.skills_nose.sniff_file.

sniff_link.basis: Check where a link really goes before opening it: follows the redirect chain by hand (up to 8 hops, each hop's status recorded) through the system proxy and reports the final destination host, the final HTTP status, content type and server, whether the link started at a known shortener (bit.ly, tinyurl.com, t.co and friends — they hide the destination), and the final host's TLS certificate expiry when it's HTTPS. Handler core.skills_nose.sniff_link.

sniff_text.basis: Profile a passage of text: word/character counts and reading time, the links and email addresses inside it, a language guess, how much of it is capitalised shouting — and whether it is shaped like a prompt-injection (wording that tries to instruct an AI: 'ignore your previous instructions', fake system prompts and the like). Handler core.skills_nose.sniff_text.

snooze_email.basis: Snooze one of the user's Gmail messages, list snoozed mail, or bring one back early. Handler core.google_services_gmail.snooze_email.

social_balances.basis: Net open balance per counterparty per currency, in minor units (positive = they owe him, negative = he owes them). Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_balances_handler.

social_debt_add.basis: Add a debt in integer minor units (paise/cents, never floats), direction i_owe or they_owe. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_debt_add_handler.

social_debt_settle.basis: Settle a debt by id (records settled_at; the entry is kept, not erased). Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_debt_settle_handler.

social_entry_delete.basis: Delete one ledger entry by kind (occasions, promises, gifts, debts) and id. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_entry_delete_handler.

social_gift_add.basis: Add a gift record (idea, given, or received) for a person, with a description. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_gift_add_handler.

social_nudge_check.basis: Check whether a respectful nudge should fire for a person: only on a cadence the user set, for a person the user named, with its reason shown. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_nudge_check_handler.

social_nudge_pause.basis: Pause or resume a person's stay-in-touch nudges (no penalty, no streak loss). Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_nudge_pause_handler.

social_nudge_snooze.basis: Snooze a person's stay-in-touch nudges for a number of days, with no penalty. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_nudge_snooze_handler.

social_occasion_add.basis: Add an occasion (birthday, anniversary, or custom) for a person the user names, with the date parts the user supplies. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_occasion_add_handler.

social_occasion_upcoming.basis: List occasions whose next occurrence falls within the horizon, with next date, days away, and whether a lead time fired. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_occasion_upcoming_handler.

social_promise_add.basis: Add a promise with counterparty, text, and optional due/wait/until/depends/recur/party (me/them/both). Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_promise_add_handler.

social_promise_complete.basis: Complete a promise; a recurring promise spawns the next child instance, and the completed instance's history is never mutated. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_promise_complete_handler.

social_promise_list.basis: List promises visible today (wait-future hidden, until-past excluded). Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_promise_list_handler.

social_send.basis: WhatsApp send via the official wa.me Click to Chat link, with the owner sending by voice (SOCIAL — Phase 1, approved design): prepare resolves the recipient from contact cards (never guesses — a missing number or an ambiguous name refuses) and drafts the exact text for approval; open opens wa.me/<number>?text=.. Handler core.social_send.social_send.

social_stay_in_touch.basis: Set a stay-in-touch cadence the user chooses, for a person the user names, with an optional last-contact date the user logged. Handler core.decision_leaves_t4.social_stay_in_touch_handler.

solar_yield.basis: Model the buyer's own solar PV array from scratch (stdlib math — sun position, clear-sky irradiance, module/inverter yield) for sizing and quoting real arrays. Handler core.solar_yield.solar_yield.

song_length_beats.basis: Work out how many beats and bars a piece of music holds: give its length in seconds and its tempo in bpm (and beats per bar if it isn't 4). Handler core.skills_music.song_length_beats.

speak_text.basis: Read a piece of text aloud right now in the PC's built-in system voice (not VYUK's own voice). Handler core.skills_plus_voice_focus.speak_text.

speaker_check.basis: Play a short three-note test tune (C–E–G) through the speakers and report which output device it went to. Handler core.skills_senses_checks.speaker_check.

speed_distance_time.basis: Solve a speed–distance–time problem for whichever value is missing. Handler core.skills_travel.speed_distance_time.

speed_test.basis: Measure the internet speed — download, upload and latency (time to first byte) — against Cloudflare's public speed endpoints (takes up to ~35 seconds). Handler core.skills_network_wifi_net.speed_test.

spelling_bee.basis: Set the day's spelling challenge from a built-in list of 30 commonly misspelled words: gives the definition and an example sentence with the word blanked out, but never the spelling itself. Handler core.skills_study_drills.spelling_bee.

spice_substitute.basis: Find a substitute for a spice that's run out, from a table of common swaps — allspice, cardamom, cinnamon, cumin, garam masala, paprika, turmeric and more — each with how much to use compared with the original. Handler core.skills_kitchen_plan.spice_substitute.

split_bill.basis: Split a bill fairly between people, with an optional tip percentage. Handler core.skills_smart_convert.split_bill.

split_pdf.basis: Split a PDF into separate PDF files by page. Handler core.skills_media_convert.split_pdf.

ssl_cert_info.basis: Inspect a host's TLS (SSL) certificate: who it was issued to, the issuing organisation, the validity window, how many days until it expires (an expired certificate is called out loudly), the names it covers (up to 10 shown), and a verdict on whether the certificate actually covers the host asked about. Handler core.skills_network_web_diag.ssl_cert_info.

stage_lighting.basis: Run the owner's own stage / venue lighting as the supplier: Art-Net and sACN (E1.31) DMX output to the buyer's own lighting nodes on the LAN, fixture patching, scenes and chases. Handler core.stage_lighting.stage_lighting.

stand_up_nudge.basis: Hourly movement nudges on VYUK's scheduler: 'start' schedules a stand-up nudge every interval_minutes (default 60) for the next 8 hours, 'stop' cancels, 'status' reports. Handler core.skills_productivity3_focus_day.stand_up_nudge.

stargazing_score.basis: Score a night for stargazing from two numbers you supply — cloud cover percent and the moon's illumination percent (this doesn't fetch a live sky report). Handler core.skills_outdoors_sky.stargazing_score.

start_companion.basis: Start VYUK's phone companion: a small server on the local Wi-Fi only, so the phone browser becomes a remote for this laptop — live screen, touchpad, keyboard, media, clipboard, files and lock/sleep/shutdown. Handler core.companion._tool_start_companion.

start_meeting.basis: Start recording a live meeting from the microphone and save it as a dated .wav file in VYUK's recordings folder. Handler core.meeting._tool_start_meeting.

startup_impact.basis: Weigh the sign-in load: everything that starts with Windows (the same inventory list_startup_programs reads — registry Run keys for this user and all users, and both Startup folders), counted and grouped by source, with the well-known heavyweights flagged by name (Teams, OneDrive, Adobe updaters, Steam, Discord, Spotify and friends) and a plain verdict on whether sign-in is light or crowded. Handler core.skills_system_bench.startup_impact.

startup_time_report.basis: Report how long this PC took to start today versus its average over the last 7 days, from Windows' own boot-performance log (Diagnostics-Performance event 100): the total start time, how it splits between boot and getting to the desktop, and whether today was faster or slower than average. Handler core.skills_system6_boot.startup_time_report.

status_strip.basis: Show, hide or report VYUK's status strip — a thin always-on bar at the top of the screen with live CPU, memory, disk, network and battery readings (the same five vitals as the System Pulse page). Handler core.status_strip._tool_status_strip.

step_goal_math.basis: Turn a step count into the distance it covers, how long it takes to walk at a brisk pace, and what share it is of a 10,000-step day. Handler core.skills_outdoors_home.step_goal_math.

stop_companion.basis: Stop the phone companion server. Handler core.companion._tool_stop_companion.

stop_meeting.basis: Stop the meeting that is recording, transcribe it on this machine with the local speech engine, and write the notes (summary + action items) next to the recording. Handler core.meeting._tool_stop_meeting.

stopwatch.basis: A stopwatch with laps, driven by timestamps (its state — started-at epoch, banked seconds, lap splits — is kept in a small file in the app data dir, so it survives across calls). Handler core.skills_productivity2_timers.stopwatch.

story_chain.basis: Build a story together, a paragraph at a time: 'start' opens today's story with VYUK's first paragraph, 'continue' adds your paragraph (passed as text) plus her next one, 'read' shows the story so far. Handler core.skills_fun_play.story_chain.

story_dice.basis: Roll three story dice — a character, a place and a twist, drawn from VYUK's own banks (20 faces each) — and get a one-line story spark combining them, for writing prompts, improv or shaking a plot loose. Handler core.skills_creative_play.story_dice.

story_outline.basis: Build a three-act story outline by combining coherent fragments from VYUK's own banks: a protagonist (with a want), an inciting incident, an obstacle, a midpoint twist, a climax and a resolution flavour, formatted as Act 1 / Act 2 / Act 3 lines ready to read aloud or write from. Handler core.skills_creative2_words_story.story_outline.

strip_image_metadata.basis: Save a metadata-free COPY of an image: EXIF (including GPS), ICC colour profile and embedded text chunks are removed by rebuilding the file from its raw pixels, so nothing hidden rides along. Handler core.skills_files3_inspect.strip_image_metadata.

study_exam_prep.basis: Organise exam preparation (syllabi, revision sessions, practice papers) and save it as exam_prep.json in the caller's study workspace folder. Handler core.triage3_identity_redact_select.study_exam_prep_handler.

study_export_deck.basis: Export study cards to a real Anki .apkg file (Anki-compatible, stdlib only, no Anki binary needed). Handler core.study_flow_t1.study_export_deck_handler.

study_plan.basis: Create a study learning plan (goals, topics with prerequisites, time budget) and save it as plan.json in the caller's study workspace folder. Handler core.triage3_identity_redact_select.study_plan_handler.

study_practice.basis: Compose an original practice set from the user's own materials (a JSON list of {key, prompt, answer, syllabus, source} records). Handler core.study_flow_t1.study_practice_handler.

study_progress.basis: Record study progress (completed material keys and/or one local assessment {subject, results: [{topic, score, total}]}) and save it as progress.json in the caller's study workspace folder. Handler core.triage3_identity_redact_select.study_progress_handler.

study_review.basis: Record one FSRS-6 review for a scheduled study card (card_key is the deck GUID, or the material key given when the card was practised) with rating 1=Again, 2=Hard, 3=Good, 4=Easy. Handler core.study_flow_t1.study_review_handler.

study_session.basis: One full study flow: compose a practice set from the user's own materials, schedule every practised card with FSRS-6, apply any supplied reviews ({card key or material key: rating 1-4}), and export the deck as a .apkg (Anki-compatible) with provenance in its description. Handler core.study_flow_t1.study_session_handler.

subscription_audit.basis: Track subscriptions and what they quietly add up to. Handler core.skills_money_budget.subscription_audit.

summarise_text.basis: Summarise a piece of text by picking the sentences that carry it (extractive summarisation, VYUK's own TextRank port — no model, no network, nothing leaves the machine). Handler core.summary._tool_summarise_text.

sunrise_sunset.basis: Sunrise and sunset times for a place given as latitude and longitude, for a date (yyyy-mm-dd, default today), computed with the NOAA solar approximation — accurate to a few minutes. Handler core.skills_travel.sunrise_sunset.

sync_folder.basis: One-way folder sync: copy files that are new or changed from the source folder into the destination folder (folders are created as needed), so the destination matches the source. Handler core.skills_files2_pdf_files.sync_folder.

sync_folders_two_way.basis: Two-way folder sync: keep TWO local folders in step with each other — files new or changed on one side are copied to the other, so either side can be edited. Handler core.two_way_sync.sync_folders_two_way.

sync_updates.basis: What's new in the user's Gmail and Google Calendar since the last sync: new unread mail and new or changed upcoming events, through the shared sync engine (pages until exhausted, retries transient failures, remembers a watermark per source so a re-sync fetches only what's new). Handler core.google_services_sync.sync_updates.

system_event_log.basis: Read recent entries from the Windows event log (System or Application channel), filtered to errors (critical+error), warnings, or all levels. Handler core.skills_system2_processes.system_event_log.

system_surface_action.basis: Act on a system surface: list tray icons, taskbar buttons, notifications, or settings pages; open a tray menu and invoke a path in it; switch to, launch, or pin a taskbar button; search Start and launch a result; act on or dismiss a notification by id and confirmed title; open a settings page. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_pack_s7consumers.S7ConsumersPacksMixin._tool_system_surface_action.

tab_census.basis: Count and list the open browser tabs through VYUK's connection to your real Chrome, grouping tabs that show the same page ('7 tabs, 3 on the same page'). Handler core.skills_web6_local.tab_census.

tail_file.basis: Show the last lines of a text file (up to 200), read backwards from the end so even a huge log opens instantly. Handler core.skills_files6_files.tail_file.

take_screenshot.basis: Capture a screenshot of the screen. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_capture_launch.ToolHandlersCaptureLaunchMixin._tool_take_screenshot.

task_scheduler_control.basis: Work with Windows scheduled tasks. Handler core.skills_system2_devices.task_scheduler_control.

teach_list_sequences.basis: List the taught sequences stored on this machine, by name. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_pack_libwire.LibwirePacksMixin._tool_teach_list_sequences.

teach_record_sequence.basis: Record a taught sequence: a named list of tool steps you spell out explicitly (each step names a tool, its arguments, and a check), stored for later replay. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_pack_libwire.LibwirePacksMixin._tool_teach_record_sequence.

teach_replay_sequence.basis: Replay a stored taught sequence through VYUK's tools, one step at a time, each step checked before the next runs. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_pack_libwire.LibwirePacksMixin._tool_teach_replay_sequence.

technical_analysis.basis: Technical analysis over OHLCV candles the operator supplies: 25 indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, SMA/EMA/WMA, ADX, CCI, PSAR, Aroon, MFI, OBV, CMF, VWAP, Stochastic, Williams %R, ROC, TSI and returns) computed in own stdlib code, plus mechanical readings of the values. Handler core.technical_analysis.technical_analysis.

tempo_terms.basis: Translate between Italian tempo words and beats per minute, both ways. Handler core.skills_music.tempo_terms.

text_diff.basis: Compare two blocks of text line by line and show a unified diff — lines starting with '-' are only in the first text, '+' only in the second. Handler core.skills_dev_explain.text_diff.

text_stats.basis: Measure a text: characters (and without spaces), words, sentences (approximate — counted from ending punctuation), paragraphs, lines, average word length, estimated reading time (200 words/minute) and speaking time (130 words/minute), and the 5 most frequent words (common stopwords excluded, ties alphabetical). Handler core.skills_text.text_stats.

tic_tac_toe.basis: Play tic-tac-toe against VYUK — the user is X, VYUK is O. Handler core.skills_games_classic.tic_tac_toe.

tile_windows.basis: Arrange all open windows neatly on the primary monitor's work area (the screen minus the taskbar): 'grid' (default, near-square), 'columns' (side by side, full height) or 'rows' (stacked, full width). Handler core.skills_desktop_tiling.tile_windows.

time_sync_status.basis: Say plainly whether this PC's clock is actually being kept in sync: on Windows, the last successful sync time and its source from w32tm — or that it has never synced, or that the Windows Time service isn't running; on Linux, timedatectl's synchronized verdict. Handler core.skills_system_net_admin.time_sync_status.

time_tracker.basis: Local working-time tracker: record working time against projects with tags, start/stop a live timer, add manual records, and read status and reports in decimal hours. Handler core.time_tracker.time_tracker.

timeline_recap.basis: Recap what VYUK's watchers noticed today (or yesterday): how many things were logged, grouped by kind (battery, downloads, network, heavy load, returns from idle, and the rest), plus the latest few notices verbatim with their times. Handler core.skills_senses_reports.timeline_recap.

timezone_convert.basis: Convert a time between two IANA time zones: give 'HH:MM' (interpreted on today's date in the source zone) or a full ISO datetime, plus the source and destination zones ('Asia/Kolkata', 'America/New_York', 'UTC', ...). Handler core.skills_productivity2_convert_query.timezone_convert.

timezone_meeting_planner.basis: Take a clock time in one city and show what that same moment is in several other cities today — handy for scheduling a call across timezones. Handler core.skills_travel.timezone_meeting_planner.

tip_and_tax.basis: Itemise a bill: the tax amount, a tip worked out on the bill before tax, and the total — and when it's split, what each person pays, with any rounding leftover honestly flagged. Handler core.skills_money_growth.tip_and_tax.

toggle_dark_mode.basis: Switch Windows' theme between dark and light — both the system chrome and apps that follow the system setting. Handler core.skills_desktop_prefs.toggle_dark_mode.

top_processes.basis: List the processes using the most memory or CPU right now, heaviest first, each with its name, PID and figure — e.g. Handler core.skills_system2_processes.top_processes.

trace_route.basis: Trace the network route to a host hop by hop (Windows tracert / Linux traceroute), showing each router that answers and its response times. Handler core.skills_network_diag.trace_route.

train_custom_wake_word.basis: Train a custom wake-word model for a phrase you choose ('computer', 'hey jarvis', your name) from synthetic speech rendered by the on-device voice — no real audio collection. Handler core.voice.wake_training.train_custom_wake_word.

transcribe_audio.basis: Transcribe one .wav recording from VYUK's recordings folder into text, using the local speech engine on this machine. Handler core.meeting._tool_transcribe_audio.

translations.basis: Manage UI string localization (keys, translations and locales): projects, keys, translations per language, import/export in JSON/PO/XLIFF, and machine translation with the product's own Gemini key. Handler core.translations._handler.

travel_door_to_door.basis: PLAN RECORD ONLY, NO COMMERCIAL ROUTING: return a door-to-door plan descriptor from caller-supplied legs in order (P19-12, non-commercial-routing form). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_door_to_door_handler.

travel_loadout.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOTHING APPLIED: return a loadout descriptor from a caller-supplied name plus capability and rule labels (P20-1, non-hardware form). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_loadout_handler.

travel_recipe.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOTHING SHARED: return a shareable recipe descriptor from caller-supplied steps plus source as supplied (P23-25). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_recipe_handler.

travel_record.basis: RECORD ONLY, NOTHING BOOKED, PAID, ROUTED, DRIVEN, RENDERED, OR MOVED: re-validate a caller-supplied travel descriptor (trip, door-to-door, transport, loadout, scene, spatial, sonify, recipe, or scoreboard) by re-running the builder that made it, and write only the travel record to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.travel_tools.travel_record_handler.

travel_scene.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOT A RENDER: return a hologram or scene descriptor from caller-supplied scene labels (P20-6 Pepper's ghost, a classic illusion, not a true hologram). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_scene_handler.

travel_scoreboard.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOTHING SCORED: return an open scoreboard descriptor from caller-supplied graduation-evidence entries only, item plus evidence reference as supplied (P23-26). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_scoreboard_handler.

travel_sonify.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOT A SOUND: return a sonification cue-map descriptor from caller-supplied state and cue labels (P20-10, non-hardware form). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_sonify_handler.

travel_spatial.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOTHING READ LIVE: return a spatial-desktop descriptor from caller-supplied zone labels (P20-7 layout record; P20-9 augmented labels, label records only, confidence refused). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_spatial_handler.

travel_transport.basis: HANDLER NOTE ONLY, NEVER A DRIVER: return a transport-handler descriptor from a caller-supplied mode label (P19 chauffeur position: handler yes, literal driver no). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_transport_handler.

travel_trip.basis: DESCRIPTOR ONLY, NOTHING BOOKED OR ROUTED: return a trip descriptor from caller-supplied legs only (P19 trip pack, packing checklist, parking note, accessibility note as supplied, never inferred). Handler core.travel_tools.travel_trip_handler.

trip_countdown.basis: Count down to a trip or any future date: how many days away it is, in words — 'in 23 days', 'tomorrow', 'today!' — plus which weekday it falls on. Handler core.skills_travel.trip_countdown.

trivia_quiz.basis: Play a five-question trivia round from VYUK's built-in bank (48+ timeless general-knowledge questions across science, geography, history, sport, arts and tech — no facts that expire). Handler core.skills_games_quiz.trivia_quiz.

trust_describe.basis: DESCRIBE ONLY, NOTHING SENT OR PUBLISHED: describe the trust centre, AI transparency, help/diagnostic bundle, known-issues feed, support runbook, plain-language changelog, or first audience, from caller-supplied fields only. Handler core.trust_spine_tools.trust_describe_handler.

trust_record.basis: RECORD ONLY, NOTHING SENT OR PUBLISHED: re-validate a caller-supplied trust/help/changelog descriptor (trust, transparency, help, issues, runbook, changelog, or audience) by re-running the builder that made it, and write only the trust record to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.trust_spine_tools.trust_record_handler.

tuning_cents.basis: Say how far apart two frequencies are in cents — hundredths of a semitone. Handler core.skills_music.tuning_cents.

two_way_sync_status.basis: List every known two-way sync pair and its last run: the two folders, how many files are in step, when it last synced, and which conflicts are still open. Handler core.two_way_sync.two_way_sync_status.

type_clipboard.basis: Type the clipboard's text into the focused app as real keystrokes — for fields that block pasting, like some password-style or remote-desktop fields. Handler core.skills_hands3_capture_scroll.type_clipboard.

type_text.basis: Type text into whatever app is currently focused, as if typed on the keyboard. Handler core.desktop.control_input.type_text.

typing_test.basis: Run a typing test. Handler core.skills_study_drills.typing_test.

uia_click_control.basis: Click a UI control by its visible name using Windows UI Automation — more reliable than pixel coordinates. Handler core.desktop.uia_click.uia_click_control.

uia_find_control.basis: Find UI controls by name in the foreground window (or a window whose title contains window_title) using Windows UI Automation, and REPORT the matches — each with its name, class, control type and on-screen rectangle — without touching anything. Handler core.desktop.uia_discover.uia_find_control.

uia_read_tree.basis: Read the UI Automation control tree of the foreground window (or a window whose title contains window_title): an indented outline of controls with names and types, bounded by max_depth (default 3) and max_nodes (default 80). Handler core.desktop.uia_discover.uia_read_tree.

uia_type_text.basis: Type text into a named text field (search box, form field, editor) using Windows UI Automation: finds the field by its label/name in the foreground window (or a window whose title contains window_title), focuses it and sets its text. Handler core.desktop.uia_type.uia_type_text.

undo_cannot_list.basis: Show, BEFORE any change, the list of change classes that cannot be taken back (sent messages, completed purchases, published posts, deleted files with no backup, system changes that already restarted the machine, extension revocations, and mission journal entries appended as audit records), plus the classes that CAN be taken back with a verified restorer. Handler core.undo_tools.undo_cannot_list_handler.

undo_last_change.basis: Undo the last change that can be taken back, through the shared undo gate: non-undoable newer changes are skipped and listed, a missing restorer or a tripped failsafe refuses plainly, and a restoration is reported only when the restorer verified it by reading back. Handler core.undo_tools.undo_last_change_handler.

undo_status.basis: Show the undo store summary: every recorded change, whether it can be taken back, whether it was taken back, the last undoable change, the covered undoable classes, and the cannot-undo list. Handler core.undo_tools.undo_status_handler.

uninstall_app.basis: Uninstall an app by name via winget — the removal is verified against winget's installed list (an app winget doesn't manage falls back to the uninstaller Windows has on record for it). Handler core.skills_plus_apps_files.uninstall_app.

unit_convert.basis: Convert a quantity between units of the same kind: length (mm cm m km in ft yd mi), mass (mg g kg t oz lb stone), volume (ml l tsp tbsp cup pint quart gallon floz), data (bit B KB MB GB TB PB, 1024-based), data rate (bps kbps mbps gbps and KB/s MB/s GB/s), speed (mps kmh mph knot), time (ms s min h day week), pressure (pa kpa mpa bar mbar psi atm), energy (j kj mj cal kcal wh kwh btu — food energy and electricity units included), temperature (c f k). Handler core.skills_smart.unit_convert.

unsubscribe_finder.basis: Scan recent inbox mail for List-Unsubscribe headers and list each sender you could unsubscribe from, with the mechanism (a one-click link or an unsubscribe email address). Handler core.skills_productivity3_life_admin.unsubscribe_finder.

update_plan_step.basis: Mark one step of a plan as completed or skipped as work progresses. Handler core.brain.planner_plans.update_plan_step.

update_restart_planner.basis: Suggest a good time to restart for Windows updates — it never schedules or forces anything. Handler core.skills_system6_diag.update_restart_planner.

url_encode_decode.basis: Percent-encode text so it is safe inside a URL (spaces become '+', '&' becomes '%26'), or decode a URL-encoded string back into plain text. Handler core.skills_dev_convert.url_encode_decode.

use_toolbox.basis: Reach every tool that is not loaded directly this session. Handler core.funnel.toolbox_findcall.use_toolbox.

uuid_generate.basis: Generate UUIDs — one by default, up to 10 at a time. Handler core.skills_dev_convert.uuid_generate.

uv_advice.basis: Give sun-protection advice for a UV index number you supply — this doesn't fetch a live forecast, it reads your number against the standard bands (0–2 low up to 11+ extreme) and says what protection each band calls for. Handler core.skills_outdoors_sky.uv_advice.

vcard_export.basis: Export contacts to a vCard 3.0 file natively (stdlib only, vobject NOT used). Handler core.creative_dev_social_t2.vcard_export_handler.

vcard_import.basis: Import vCard 3.0 text natively (stdlib only, vobject NOT used) into per-card people fields: name, phones, emails, and note (organisation/title as stated text). Handler core.creative_dev_social_t2.vcard_import_handler.

vehicle_routes.basis: Plan advanced vehicle routes the operator describes: time-windowed delivery routes (VRPTW), pickup-and-delivery shipments, multi-depot fleets with different vehicles, and vehicle skills, breaks and working hours. Handler core.vehicle_routes.vehicle_routes.

virtual_desktop.basis: Work with Windows virtual desktops (Task View desktops): 'next' and 'previous' send the Win+Ctrl+arrow shortcuts, 'create' sends Win+Ctrl+D for a new desktop. Handler core.skills_desktop_prefs.virtual_desktop.

vocab_word.basis: Give the word of the day from a built-in list of 24 useful words: the word, what it means, and an example sentence. Handler core.skills_study_drills.vocab_word.

voice_agent.basis: Answer phone calls with a voice agent the owner builds: write call scripts (say / gather / branch / transfer / hangup) and run them on a real phone line through the operator's own SIP trunk (trunk credentials are supplied per call, never stored). Handler core.voice_agent.voice_agent.

voice_memos.basis: List your recorded voice memos and play one back. Handler core.skills_senses_checks.voice_memos.

voice_note.basis: Record a voice memo (3 to 120 seconds) and save it as a WAV file in ~/Music/Nova, with a text transcript saved beside it when transcription is set up on this PC — and an honest note in that file when it isn't. Handler core.skills_senses_checks.voice_note.

vpn_control.basis: Check or change saved Windows VPN connections (rasdial). Handler core.skills_system2_devices.vpn_control.

wake_on_lan.basis: Send a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to power on a sleeping or shut-down PC over the local network, given its network adapter's MAC address; repeat (1-5) resends the packet for reliability. Handler core.skills_network_wake_shares.wake_on_lan.

walk_time.basis: Work out how long a walk takes and what it adds up to. Handler core.skills_outdoors_home.walk_time.

wallpaper_apply.basis: Apply the wallpaper the state pilot picks for an hour, from art paths YOU supply — once, on demand, after human confirmation (confirm-gated). Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_pack_libwire.LibwirePacksMixin._tool_wallpaper_apply.

wallpaper_revert.basis: Restore the desktop wallpaper VYUK last changed, to exactly what it was immediately before that change (image + style) — once, on demand, after human confirmation (confirm-gated). Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_pack_libwire.LibwirePacksMixin._tool_wallpaper_revert.

wallpaper_state.basis: Resolve which wallpaper the state pilot picks for an hour, from art paths YOU supply. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_pack_libwire.LibwirePacksMixin._tool_wallpaper_state.

wardrobe.basis: Keep the owner's own wardrobe — garments, outfits, daily suggestions, schedule and wear history. Handler core.wardrobe.wardrobe.

warehouse_stock.basis: Run a small warehouse or storage unit: stock locations with quantities, inbound (receive), outbound (ship), moves between locations, and per-location occupancy, so one operator can see what's where and how full each unit is. Handler core.skills_admin_lend_assets.warehouse_stock.

warranty_log.basis: Log purchases with their warranties and know when cover runs out. Handler core.skills_admin_vault_logs.warranty_log.

watch_gestures.basis: Watch the camera for hand gestures and face presence for a bounded time (default 10 seconds, at most 30), then report what was actually seen — the gestures that held long enough to trust (open palm, fist, pinch, point, wave, swipe left/right) and how many frames showed a face or a hand. Handler core.desktop.control_plus_files.watch_gestures.

watcher_status.basis: Report whether VYUK's background watchers can actually watch: whether the machine probes (psutil) are available, the battery and load readings right now, how often the watchers poll, and the most recent notice of each kind from the Senses timeline. Handler core.skills_senses_reports.watcher_status.

watchlist.basis: Keep a watchlist of films and shows to watch. Handler core.skills_notes.watchlist.

water_break.basis: Gentle recurring hydration reminders on VYUK's scheduler: 'start' schedules a nudge every interval_minutes (default 30) for the next 8 hours, 'snooze' pushes the next one back by snooze_minutes, 'stop' cancels them, 'status' reports what's left. Handler core.skills_productivity3_focus_day.water_break.

water_intake_math.basis: Work out a daily water target from body weight, using the standard rule of thumb of 35 ml per kilogram plus 350 ml for every 30 minutes of activity. Handler core.skills_habits_tracking.water_intake_math.
