watermark_image.basis: Stamp a text watermark onto ONE image, saving the result as a NEW file — the original is never touched. Handler core.skills_photo_finish.watermark_image.

wayback_lookup.basis: Find the closest snapshot of a web page in the Internet Archive (the Wayback Machine): when the nearest capture was taken and its archive URL, or an honest 'no snapshots' when the page was never archived. Handler core.skills_web_research.wayback_lookup.

web_search.basis: Perform a live internet search and return a factual summary. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_web_search.

webcam_snapshot.basis: Capture a single frame from the webcam and save it as a JPEG (default location: ~/Pictures/nova_webcam_<timestamp>.jpg). Handler core.desktop.control_plus_files.webcam_snapshot.

website_status.basis: Check whether a website is really up: fetches the page (browser-like, redirects followed, never more than 64 KB read) and reports the HTTP status code in plain words (up / refused the page / site erroring), the response time, the final URL after redirects and the server software when it says. Handler core.skills_network_web_diag.website_status.

well_break_plan.basis: SUGGESTION ONLY, NEVER A PRESCRIPTION: return a break-plan descriptor from caller-supplied work minutes, break minutes, and focus-stretch minutes — work in focus stretches with a rest moment between them, then the break. Handler core.well_tools.well_break_plan_handler.

well_day_summary.basis: TOTALS ONLY, NOTHING MEASURED: total caller-supplied day numbers — work minutes, breaks taken, break minutes — and return the totals. Handler core.well_tools.well_day_summary_handler.

well_record_plan.basis: RECORD ONLY, NOTHING SCHEDULED, NOTHING MEASURED: re-validate a caller-supplied wellbeing plan (break, reminder, or wind-down) by re-running the builder that made it, and write only the plan record to a caller-chosen .json file in an already-existing folder. Handler core.well_tools.well_record_plan_handler.

well_reminder.basis: WORDS ONLY, NOTHING SCHEDULED: return a reminder descriptor from caller-supplied trigger words and a time — the reminder wording, in plain words. Handler core.well_tools.well_reminder_handler.

well_winddown.basis: ROUTINE ONLY, FIXED NON-MEDICAL STEPS: return a wind-down routine from caller-chosen steps, each from the fixed non-medical list (dim the lights, stretch gently, step away from the screen, drink some water, take a few slow breaths, tidy one small thing, put the phone in another room), in the order given. Handler core.well_tools.well_winddown_handler.

whats_pending.basis: Show everything live right now in one view: reminders still waiting (what and when), whether the stopwatch is running and at what time, and the Pomodoro's round state. Handler core.skills_productivity5_logs.whats_pending.

wifi_dead_spot_map.basis: Map Wi-Fi dead spots room by room. Handler core.skills_system6_diag.wifi_dead_spot_map.

wifi_info.basis: Show the current Wi-Fi connection: network name, connected state, signal strength, radio type, channel, security type and access-point address, and this PC's local IP address. Handler core.skills_network_wifi_net.wifi_info.

window_always_on_top.basis: Pin a window (matched by part of its title) so it stays on top of all other windows, or unpin it. Handler core.skills_network_display_input.window_always_on_top.

window_control.basis: List open windows, or focus/minimize/maximize/close a window whose title contains the given text. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_window_control.

window_opacity.basis: Make a window (matched by part of its title) see-through: give an opacity from 30 to 100 percent. Handler core.skills_network_display_input.window_opacity.

window_pin_toggle_all.basis: Unpin every always-on-top window at once, so nothing floats above the other windows any more — the recovery move when a pinned window traps the screen. Handler core.skills_hands3_window_manip.window_pin_toggle_all.

window_place.basis: Place a named window where you want it: snap it to one half, third or corner of its own screen (left, right, top, bottom, left-third, center-third, right-third, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) or maximise it — or move/resize it to exact pixels. Handler core.desktop.pywinctl_wrapper.window_place.

window_snap.basis: Snap the window you're using to one half or quarter of its screen (left, right, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) or maximise it, with exact positioning — including the corners, which the Win+arrow keys can't reach. Handler core.skills_hands3_window_manip.window_snap.

windows_update_status.basis: Windows Update status from the registry: when Windows last successfully checked for updates, and whether a restart is pending to finish installing them (the component-servicing and Windows Update reboot flags). Handler core.skills_system_bench.windows_update_status.

winget_install.basis: Install a desktop app using winget, the Windows package manager. Handler core.skills_system_apps_startup.winget_install.

winget_upgrade_all.basis: Update every app that winget manages to its latest version, in one go. Handler core.skills_system_apps_startup.winget_upgrade_all.

wishlist.basis: Keep a wishlist of things you want. Handler core.skills_notes.wishlist.

word_frequency.basis: Count the 15 most frequent words in a text, with counts and each word's share of the total. Handler core.skills_words_measure.word_frequency.

word_game.basis: Play a Wordle-style word game: VYUK picks a five-letter target word from its built-in list and the user has 6 guesses. Handler core.skills_games_word.word_game.

word_of_the_day.basis: Give one interesting word for today from a built-in bank of about 40 — the same word all day, a new one tomorrow. Handler core.skills_fun_daily.word_of_the_day.

workflow_build_plan.basis: Turn a distilled workflow into a PROPOSED loop plan (sequential dependencies, evidence refs, proposed_only, executes_nothing). Handler core.integration_harness_tools_handlers.workflow_build_plan_handler.

workflow_distil.basis: Distil caller-supplied proven jobs into a reusable workflow (steps with source job + evidence ref, duplicates reported). Handler core.integration_harness_tools_handlers.workflow_distil_handler.

workflow_runs.basis: Show recent workflow runs with their states and per-node counts, newest first — the record of what actually happened, not a claim. Handler core.dagflow.workflow_runs_handler.

workflow_to_playbook_steps.basis: Convert a workflow to plain step texts + proof references for a CALLER to add through the existing J9 playbook (the loop's single playbook store). Handler core.integration_harness_tools_handlers.workflow_to_playbook_steps_handler.

world_clock.basis: The current local time in a city anywhere in the world, with its UTC offset and how far ahead or behind the user it is. Handler core.skills_smart.world_clock.

wormhole_offer.basis: Offer one file to another machine on this network, with a short single-use code phrase: 'start' offers the named file (the reply gives the phrase and the address to read out), 'status' reports what is offered, 'cancel' stops offering. Handler core.wormhole._tool_wormhole_offer.

wormhole_receive.basis: Claim a file another machine on this network offered: give the code phrase the sender read out, the sender's address (like 192.168.1.5:8766), and the folder (or full file path) to save into. Handler core.wormhole._tool_wormhole_receive.

wormhole_status.basis: What is currently offered on this network, and the recent transfers. Handler core.wormhole._tool_wormhole_status.

write_clipboard.basis: Copy text to the system clipboard, replacing whatever is on it now. Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_command_url.ToolHandlersCommandUrlMixin._tool_write_clipboard.

write_file.basis: Write text content to a file on disk, replacing the file (or adding to its end with append=true). Handler core.funnel.tools_handlers_data_services.ToolHandlersDataServicesMixin._tool_write_file.

writing_prompt.basis: Deal a fresh writing prompt by combining a protagonist, a situation, a twist and a setting from VYUK's own fragment banks. Handler core.skills_creative_sound_words.writing_prompt.

zip_control.basis: Zip archive operations: 'zip' a file or folder into a .zip, 'unzip' an archive (refuses archives whose members would escape the destination folder), 'list_zip' to see contents without extracting (each entry's size plus the total uncompressed size). Handler core.desktop.control_plus_files.zip_control.
